name: Geko Internet
summary: Dialup/ADSL/network-solutions ISP; acquired by Hotkey Internet Services ~2002 (GEKO INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 081 197 668).

events.details: Acquired by Hotkey Internet Services. Geko-branded ISP homepage last archived May 2001; geko.com.au had become a Hotkey-branded frame by ~Mar 2002, matching the c. 2001-02 absorption proposal. absorbed by Hotkey Internet.

refs.label: May 2001: homepage still titled 'Geko Internet' with Geko support/sales/'check your usage' sections - last Geko-branded capture.
The geko.com.au homepage (JS redirector from 2002-01-26 per CDX) framed a fully Hotkey-branded site ('Join HOTKEY today') by early Mar 2002.
By Jun 2003 the domain openly served the Hotkey splash; Geko branding never returned.
